chapters.title: Qwen3-VL-8B — and the same three, asked for detail
chapters.subtitle: greedy · 296 tokens, run to its own stop · 95-token prompt with the image · RTX 5090
chapters.note: the transformers host, unedited · TTFT and decode are reported separately, never blended into one tokens/second
chapters.footer:
decode 65.6 -> 82.9 -> 145.7 tok/s: 2.22x over the host as shipped, 1.76x over the host's own compiled static-cache form, finishing at 4.52 s, 3.60 s and 2.06 s. TTFT is ~30 ms in all three panes — this film is about the decode half, and prefill is not where the work went.
Judged step by step on the host's own sequence: teacher-forced same-token 0.9932 here, and 1.0000 on the short question above. Free-running, the compiled arm agrees with the host for 291 of 296 tokens; the attached arm agrees for 77, then says 'counter' where the host says 'table' and follows its own continuation. That cascade is why the gate is the teacher-forced rate and not free-run agreement. 180 seams plus the lm_head, bound automatically; the attached arm repeats bitwise across three runs.
